    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]

    [#AF87FF]inputs-core[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]

    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]

    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]

    [#AF87FF]gate-actions-ace[dim] · [dim][/dim]after gate-actions[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]gate-actions-ace: render an Actions section in the shared gate modals, [/#D7D7AF]
